definitions.explanation: A paper or wooden charm obtained from a shrine or temple, believed to provide divine protection or blessings.

examples.japanese: ⟦{神社|じんじゃ}→神社：01620_jinja⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧お{札|ふだ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I received a paper charm at the shrine.

examples.japanese: お{札|ふだ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{神棚|かみだな}→神棚：13740_kamidana⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{祀|まつ}る→祭る：03932_matsuru⟧。
examples.english: I enshrine the paper charm on the household altar.

examples.japanese: ⟦{初詣|はつもうで}→初詣：05804_hatsumoude⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧お{札|ふだ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I buy a new paper charm during the New Year's shrine visit.

notes:
USAGE: お{札|ふだ} is a respectful form with the honorific お prefix. The word ⟦{札|ふだ}→札：23002_fuda⟧ alone means "tag" or "label."

CULTURAL NOTE:
- Traditionally placed in the ⟦{神棚|かみだな}→神棚：13740_kamidana⟧ (household Shinto altar)
- Should be replaced annually, typically during ⟦{初詣|はつもうで}→初詣：05804_hatsumoude⟧ (first shrine visit of the year)
- Old お{札|ふだ} are returned to shrines for ritual burning (お⟦{焚|た}き{上|あ}げ→お焚き上げ：noentry⟧)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- お{札|ふだ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{祀|まつ}る→祭る：03932_matsuru⟧ (to enshrine a charm)
- お{札|ふだ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧/⟦{頂|いただ}く→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧ (to buy/receive a charm)
- お{札|ふだ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{返|かえ}す→返す：09648_kaesu⟧ (to return an old charm)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦お{守|まも}り→お守り：05955_omamori⟧ - portable amulet (carried on person)
- ⟦{絵馬|えま}→絵馬：05957_ema⟧ - votive tablet
- ⟦{御朱印|ごしゅいん}→御朱印：16927_goshuin⟧ - temple/shrine seal stamp
